notes_sections.heading: Methodology correction — this run replaces an earlier same-day pass
items: An earlier 2026-09-21 run used WebFetch (anonymous HTML fetch + summarization) against Dice's search URLs and reported 22 "unique" postings including 5 that turned out to be wrong: Kforce Technology Staffing's Forward Deployed Engineer (Armonk, NY), High Bridge Consulting's Senior AI FDE, Cencora's FDE, a Kanshe Infotech Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Architect, and TechniPros' Principal Generative AI Engineer.

This browser-based re-run, done logged in as Marc's actual Dice account, confirms those 5 were never real search-result hits — they were entries from the "Similar Jobs" sidebar shown on a job-detail page, which WebFetch's markdown conversion flattened into the same list as genuine search results. Dice's own on-page result counters (e.g. "1 results (0 new)" for Forward Deployed Engineer) confirm the true, much smaller result sets used here.

Real per-query result counts this run: DevOps Engineer 4, Platform Engineer 10 (11 raw links; Dice's own count says 10, likely a dedupe on their side), Site Reliability Engineer 0, Cloud Engineer 5, DevSecOps Engineer 3, Forward Deployed Engineer 1 — 20 unique postings total after cross-query dedupe by job ID.

Net effect: the earlier run's "ineligible" entry (Kforce) is not one of this rotation's 20 top-level query hits, so it's kept out of that count — but it is a real, still-live posting (confirmed via its own detail page, Dice tags: Contract W2, On-site, $130-150 hourly), so it's listed in the main table below scored -1 / "Ineligible" rather than silently dropped.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions — screened out by title, not opened for full validation
items: 11 of the remaining 16 real unique postings were off-domain by title: 4× Salesforce (Tech Lead, 3× Developer), 2× Oracle Cloud (Order to Cash / Fusion Functional Consultant), 1× SAP Commerce Solutions Architect, and 4× further AI/Generative-AI-flavored roles (AI/ML Engineer, Gen AI Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, Senior AI Agent Platform Engineer) consistent with the pattern confirmed above.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: All six default titles searched via Claude in Chrome against dice.com, logged in as Marc's own account (not anonymous) — this matches how a human would actually use the site and is the more trustworthy method for this JS-heavy search UI going forward. Prefer this over WebFetch for Dice in future runs.

One genuinely new posting this run: TechniPros "Senior DevOps Engineer" (job-detail/715868bc), posted 14 minutes before this check — strong direct skill match, scored 7, but same employer/on-site-rotation pattern Marc has skipped twice before (2026-09-19) for the on-site condition.
TechniPros' DevSecOps Engineer posting (job-detail/06ab958a) is still live and unchanged from 2026-09-19's scoring; it has not yet been added to applications.md.
Quantum Technologies, Shiro Technologies, and GlobalLogic postings are carried forward from 2026-09-19 with pipeline status pulled directly from applications.md — not re-scored.
No CAPTCHA or write-side action occurred.

method: Six-query default rotation against Dice's remote + willing-to-sponsor + Canada country-code filter, past 7 days, full-time or contract, run via logged-in browser session (Claude in Chrome) rather than anonymous WebFetch after WebFetch was found to conflate real search results with job-detail "Similar Jobs" sidebar suggestions. 20 unique real search results after dedup; 1 new eligible posting scored, 1 known-but-unfiled posting carried forward, 3 known pipeline postings carried forward with current applications.md status, 4 opened and read in full then scored 0 / "Out of scope" (cloud-security-specialist, ML/AI-infrastructure, application-layer-AI, and GCP-hard-gate roles), 1 opened and read in full then scored -1 / "Ineligible" (confirmed on-site, no remote option, in a non-reachable US city), 11 screened out by title alone as off-domain (Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, further AI/GenAI-flavored).
